nodes.statement: Finite outcome type iota, finite arm type K, and integer query cap D >= 0; K may be empty if a suitable policy exists.
One supplied normalized fresh pure state psi is used in every block; no quantum state crosses a boundary.
E and F are two actual unitary oracle families indexed by K. Known gates in every plan are unitary mathematical inputs.

One deterministic policy is shared by E and F and depends only on prior classical outcome lists. A Plan has an arm, a chronological word of known unitaries / forward calls / inverse calls, and a proof q(h) <= D. Empty words are allowed.
For each arm i, ||E_i - F_i||op <= eta_i. This is the only environment-distance premise.
Trace(0) = Unit and Trace(n+1) = Trace(n) x iota, with prior trace first and new outcome second. Trace(n) is finite.
list(()) = [] and list((h,j)) = list(h) ++ [j]. Therefore list(h) has length n for h in Trace(n).

The chronological history map is injective and has length n. Consequently it bijects Trace(n) with length-n lists; use these proved properties in point-mass identities, rather than infer Hellinger invariance from pushforward equality alone.

nodes.statement: At trace h, select the same plan policy(list(h)) in both environments, hence the same a(h), chronological word, and q(h).
Actual evaluation of every selected chronological word is unitary in E and F, including inverse calls and the empty word.

nodes.statement: Evaluating a selected word on psi produces a state of norm one in each environment.
k_E(h,j) and k_F(h,j) are the existing actual computational-basis output probabilities of the selected word on psi under its selected arm's oracle. Measurement is the existing basis measurement.
For all histories and outcomes, k_E(h,j) >= 0 and k_F(h,j) >= 0, from actual basis probability formulas, not an extra kernel premise.
For every history h, sum_j k_E(h,j) = sum_j k_F(h,j) = 1, from word unitarity and normalized input.
H2(p,q) = sum_x (sqrt(p_x) - sqrt(q_x))^2 on a finite index type, without a factor 1/2.

For arbitrary nonnegative finite parent densities p,q and normalized nonnegative kernels k,l: H2(p*k,q*l) = H2(p,q) + sum_h sqrt(p_h*q_h) * H2(k_h,l_h). Parent normalization is not a premise. Expand finite product sums, square roots of nonnegative products, squares, and use each kernel's mass one.
For nonnegative real p,q: 0 <= sqrt(p*q) and 2*sqrt(p*q) <= p+q. Thus sqrt(p*q) <= (p+q)/2.
Inverse oracle calls satisfy ||E_i^(-1) - F_i^(-1)||op <= eta_i, using unitarity and ||E_i^(-1) - F_i^(-1)||op = ||E_i - F_i||op or its sufficient inequality.

Inductively p_E(n,h) >= 0 and p_F(n,h) >= 0.
Inductively sum_h p_E(n,h) = sum_h p_F(n,h) = 1, by finite product-sum factorization and actual kernel mass one.

nodes.statement: w(h) = q(h)*eta[a(h)]^2 >= 0. Both forward and inverse oracle calls are counted; only the arm selected at h is charged.
C(0,()) = 0 and C(n+1,(h,j)) = C(n,h) + w(list(h)). Charge is chosen from the prior history and does not depend on the new outcome j.
C(n,h) >= 0 by induction from nonnegative charges.
EC_E(n) = sum_h p_E(n,h)*C(n,h), and similarly EC_F. These are the two environments' own expectations of the same pathwise cost function.
EC_E(0) = EC_F(0) = 0; EC_E(n+1) = EC_E(n)+A_E(n), and EC_F(n+1) = EC_F(n)+A_F(n). Expand joint sums and use normalization of the actual conditional kernels.
H2(p_E(n+1),p_F(n+1)) <= H2(p_E(n),p_F(n)) + (D/2)*(A_E(n)+A_F(n)). Bound each chain term by D*w(h)*sqrt(p_E*p_F), then use AM-GM and nonnegative D*w(h).

boundary_cases: n = 0: both trace densities are the singleton mass one, C = 0, and H2 = 0.
q = 0 / empty word: the per-word perturbation and charged cost are zero; actual kernels coincide for the shared known-unitary word.
D = 0: the policy query cap forces all q = 0, giving zero root bound.

Empty K: a total Plan-producing policy on all outcome lists cannot exist because [] is a history and every Plan must contain an arm. The phrase 'possibly zero if a policy exists' is conditional and does not assert that such a policy exists.

Empty iota: normalized computational-basis probabilities on iota cannot exist, so the normalized fresh-state model prevents nonvacuous instances unless outcome indexing differs from what the source says.
Histories of zero probability: the deterministic policy and actual kernels are still defined there; the finite identity does not divide by parent mass.

Negative eta on a selected arm is inconsistent with ||E_i-F_i||op <= eta_i. Squared weights are nonnegative without a separate sign hypothesis; any step squaring a non-squared perturbation estimate must establish its right-hand side is nonnegative.
The cost and horizon quantify over literal traces. No almost-sure-only horizon variant is explicitly specified.
Clarified sealed budget T is Nat and must bound existing historyQueryCost; a real-valued route is a separate generalization.

A pushforward-law equality does not alone establish Hellinger invariance; explicit actual PMF point masses, toReal conversion, injectivity, and length n are required for the finite-trace interpretation.

The source cites existing per-word mathematics without giving its exact statement. To justify D*q*eta_arm^2, that mathematics must handle actual normalized basis masses, chronological mixed forward/inverse words, and count every inverse call. The reconstruction exposes sufficient prerequisites but cannot certify the cited implementation.

Clarification resolves the sealed horizon as T : Nat, a count of actual forward plus inverse calls measured by existing historyQueryCost. The original real-budget route remains separate; no proof of all real-T variants or random stopping is claimed.
A total list policy that returns an arm rules out an empty arm type in any inhabited instance; the source's empty-K phrase is conditionally harmless but vacuous for the stated total policy model.

The general H2 identity and D/2 weighted coefficient are algebraically consistent. With nonnegative kernels and normalized kernel rows, parent normalization is unnecessary. The chain bound and expected-cost recurrence give the advertised induction; normalizing trace masses is needed for the uniform-horizon expectation bound and PMF bridge. This is a source-level assessment, not a proof or Lean verification.
